'''Shira''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She was [[Reom]]'s sister and worked for [[IsoTech]]. She was in charge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] business.
